settings.heading: Grow your clinical practice with us
settings.subheading: Clinical supervision toward licensure, EMDR consultation toward EMDRIA certification, and opportunities to join our team.

settings.title: Clinical Supervision
settings.heading: Clinical Supervision
settings.content: Supervision offers a space to deepen clinical skill, strengthen case conceptualization, and support thoughtful professional growth, grounded in reflection and clinical integrity. Available for LPC associates and PsyD trainees working toward licensure.

settings.title: EMDR Consultation
settings.heading: EMDR Consultation
settings.content: As a Certified EMDR Therapist and EMDRIA Approved Consultant, Dr. Serravalle provides consultation that strengthens EMDR case conceptualization and supports clinicians working toward EMDRIA certification.

settings.title: Join Our Team
settings.heading: Join Our Team
settings.content: We are always interested in connecting with clinicians who share our commitment to trauma-informed, relationally grounded care. Learn about current openings and what it is like to work at Center for Balanced Living.

settings.body: Reach out to discuss supervision, consultation, or joining our team.
